status: prospective; no competition-data CatBoost BPE fit performed
reason: The only prior CatBoost baseline used raw features. Test native categorical statistics and interactions over the current deterministic value/digit/BPE representation, using the existing fixed-training implementation. This is a new model family for these features, rather than a further residual-tree-count sweep.
validation: Exploratory full-data StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), same ordered IDs, labels and folds as R10. No independent holdout. No outer-validation early stopping, target maps fitted globally, public-score tuning or changes during training. CatBoost builds categorical statistics from each outer-training fold only.

fixed_comparisons.remaining_weight: the frozen R10 hybrid, including its existing external component
fixed_comparisons.selection: Report every comparison and choose the highest pooled OOF among eligible weights. This finite selection is exploratory, not independent validation. No additional weights may be added after seeing results.

promotion_rule: A mixture must exceed the current R10 pooled OOF by strictly more than0.0001 and improve at least4/5 corresponding folds. If none passes, retain R10 and do not submit this family. At most one submission after independent checks of folds, source/data hashes, checkpoint predictions, blend arithmetic and submission schema. No exception is preauthorized.
cost: Five fixed GPU fits on the local RTX4070 Laptop, no paid compute. A small synthetic CUDA smoke may precede training; it does not select parameters using competition labels.
training_gate: Publish this plan before fitting. Run an isolated clean worktree at its pinned published commit; record actual runtime, library versions and resolved CatBoost parameters. Abort and record incompatibility rather than silently changing device or configuration.
